answer: Nikola Tesla never won the Nobel Prize in Physics. Although rumors and myths sometimes claim he did (or that he rejected it), this is historically inaccurate. The 1915 Nobel Prize in Physics, which he never received, went to William Henry Bragg and William Lawrence Bragg for their X-ray crystallography work.
